signature.name: Half-Awake Read Time
signature.description: Whether a tired, glare-blinded user gets 'coffee, in progress' from one frozen, grayscale, blurred 120px frame, with 3:1 contrast, 4px+ shapes, a progress cue in the reduced-motion pose, and a specific accessible name.

lesson: Strong loaders put the 'in progress' meaning in a big, high-contrast silhouette that survives a frozen blurred frame; weak ones hide it in fine detail, faint opacity or motion you have to watch.

bare-wire.signature_why: v2's solid dark hole survives grayscale and blur and clears about 3:1, but it reads as a spot in a cup, not progress; aria-label is a bare 'Loading'; reduced pose is one dim scar.
bare-wire.loved: The closing hole is calm, seam-clean (frame 5.0 equals 0.0), and the pitch owns its ripple mistake.
bare-wire.docked: Top-down cup plus dark dot says 'coffee' only weakly and 'progress' barely; accessible name never mentions the order.
bare-wire.fix_note: Five clockwise scars refused as a spinner grammar and clutter, which holds against calm; the fade-in point was taken and the scar is now legible at 120px.

warm-hands.signature_why: Cup, dark coffee and cream spiral survive frozen, grayscale and blur; reduced pose holds spiral plus stream; name is specific ('your coffee is being made'); stream is only 3 units and crema-on-paper is well under 3:1.
warm-hands.loved: Big high-contrast spiral on espresso stays legible blurred, with a one-clock linear sweep that never looks stalled.
warm-hands.docked: Spiral still turns like a rosette and the new stream is thin and pale against the paper, so the pour cue is fragile in glare.
warm-hands.fix_note: Stream added, stroke thickened to 6.5 and stream held in the reduced pose, but it is 3 units and low contrast, so the spinner read is reduced, not removed.

the-glitch.signature_why: Spout, falling drop and cup read as coffee on its way even grayscale and blurred; reduced pose keeps a hanging drop and stepping crema; name is specific; the crema step cue itself fades under blur.
the-glitch.loved: Orange layer, slip and hard cuts are gone, leaving one steady drip per second that divides the 5s loop and a calm, designed reduced-motion pose.
the-glitch.docked: The crema count tops out near 80% then swaps back in 0.25s, so it can read as fill-and-empty, which undercuts 'never finishes'.
the-glitch.fix_note: Slip, ghost and hard cut deleted outright; drop now fades and squashes into the ring; the pip fade-in is moot because the pips were removed.
